en.text:
Passively grants the following benefits while a Hand Cannon is readied:
• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance

Readying a Hand Cannon grants 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 6 seconds (for the PVE-only benefits of the perk, consider this the 0th Stack).

'Illegally Modded Holster' grants the following benefits to Hand Cannons:
• 100 Ready Speed Handling
• 0.6x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• PVE ONLY: Direct Hits grant a Stack of 'Illegally Modded Holster'. Maximum of 10 Stacks.

'Illegally Modded Holster' grants 45% increased Direct Impact damage per Stack, maxing out at 450%. Boss-Tier Enemies take 33% decreased damage from Lucky Pants shots.

• <purple Uncivil Discourse /> only recieves 30% increased damage per stack.
• <yellow Sturm />'s Overcharged Rounds only receive 11% increased damage per Stack (110%). 
• <yellow Hawkmoon />'s Paracausal Shot receives 5% increased damage per stack upon being fired (50%). 
• <yellow Malfeasance />'s Explosive Shadow is unaffected by the buff.


While at 'Illegally Modded Holster x7' or higher:
Swapping to a non-Hand Cannon weapon or the buff expiring grants you the 'Out of Luck' debuff. 'Out of Luck' prevents you from reacquiring 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 10 seconds.
